me: query Me { me { id businessName owner type city phone address point { lat lng } } }
products: query Products { products { id name category unit price stock icon tag color } }
quote: query Quote($input: BasketInput!) { quote(input: $input) { items { id name category unit price stock icon tag color quantity } subtotal delivery total count currency } }
orders: query Orders($limit: Int) { orders(limit: $limit) { id merchant { id businessName owner type city phone address point { lat lng } } method status error createdAt paymentSimulated deliveryStatus items { id name category unit price stock icon tag color quantity } subtotal delivery total count currency } }
order: query Order($id: ID!) { order(id: $id) { id merchant { id businessName owner type city phone address point { lat lng } } method status error createdAt paymentSimulated deliveryStatus items { id name category unit price stock icon tag color quantity } subtotal delivery total count currency } }
createMerchant: mutation CreateMerchant($input: MerchantInput!) { createMerchant(input: $input) { token merchant { id businessName owner type city phone address point { lat lng } } } }
updateMerchant: mutation UpdateMerchant($input: MerchantInput!) { updateMerchant(input: $input) { id businessName owner type city phone address point { lat lng } } }
placeOrder: mutation PlaceOrder($input: OrderInput!, $idempotencyKey: ID!) { placeOrder(input: $input, idempotencyKey: $idempotencyKey) { id merchant { id businessName owner type city phone address point { lat lng } } method status error createdAt paymentSimulated deliveryStatus items { id name category unit price stock icon tag color quantity } subtotal delivery total count currency } }
